title: The Money Returned on a Cancelled Vacation Package
content:
The money returned on a cancelled vacation package goes back to the form of payment the package was paid from, and is worked out from what the party put into the package, what stands withheld against it, the currency the party elected to be charged in and the traveller's standing with the traveller club. This ruling of the refunds and settlements office governs every package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products.

## What the party put in, and what stands withheld

The money the party put in is every deposit and every instalment taken on the package.

The whole of what stands withheld against the package reduces what is returned, what stands withheld being every penalty and amendment charge on its ledger.

## What is added back, and what is retained

Nothing is added back to what is returned as a goodwill gesture. Nothing is retained for the currency the party elected to be charged in.

## The order in which the figures act

What is returned is the money the party put in, less the withholding that reduces it, together with anything added back as a goodwill gesture; anything retained for the currency the party elected to be charged in is taken off the figure so reached, last of all.

The money returned is settled as one payout against the package as a whole, and not line by line, and is rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package whose deposits and instalments come to 4,000.00 USD, its ledger carrying a cancellation penalty of 900.00 USD and an amendment charge of 120.00 USD, has 1,020.00 USD standing withheld against it. The whole of that reduces what is returned, leaving 2,980.00 USD. Nothing is added back as a goodwill gesture and nothing is retained for the currency elected, so the money returned is 2,980.00 USD, settled as one payout against the package as a whole and rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end.
